Provenance of the NFS-e test files in this folder - all copied unchanged

From akretion/nfelib (https://github.com/akretion/nfelib, MIT License, commit 7082879710d1400db31e0baa435a0506355e940f),
folder nfelib/nfse/samples/v1_0/ (layout 1.00 documents, which are also valid against layout 1.01):
  dps-simples.xml
  ConsultarNFSeRPS-ped-sitnfserps.xml
  ConsultarNFSeEnvio-ped-sitnfse.xml

From Unimake/Uninfe (https://github.com/Unimake/Uninfe, MIT License), folder "exemplos xml/NFSe/NACIONAL/1.01/":
  GerarNfseMinima-env-loterps.xml
  GerarNfseTagsIBSCBS-env-loterps.xml

From Unimake/DFe (https://github.com/Unimake/DFe, MIT License, commit 897f3529a83da13d485f9b5216bc9aa93b40bd5a),
file source/Unimake.DFe.Test/NFSe/Resources/NACIONAL/1.01/RetornoNACIONAL.xml:
  unimake-RetornoNACIONAL.xml (signed NFS-e 1.01 with IBSCBS from "Produção Restrita")

Adapted copies for the NT 009 layout of the schema package of 2026-10-20 (file name suffix "-nt009"):
  dps-simples-nt009.xml, ConsultarNFSeRPS-ped-sitnfserps-nt009.xml, ConsultarNFSeEnvio-ped-sitnfse-nt009.xml,
  GerarNfseMinima-env-loterps-nt009.xml, GerarNfseTagsIBSCBS-env-loterps-nt009.xml, unimake-RetornoNACIONAL-nt009.xml
  Derived from the files above with structural changes only, no values changed:
  - "finNFSe" moved from "IBSCBS" to "infDPS" (directly after "tpEmit"), where it is now mandatory - added with value "0" where missing
  - "cNBS" moved before "xDescServ" in "cServ"
  - "CST" and "cClassTrib" moved from "IBSCBS/valores/trib/gIBSCBS" directly into "trib" (the then empty "gIBSCBS" was removed)
  - "vCalcReeRepRes" (value 0.00) removed from the NFS-e "IBSCBS/valores", as it no longer exists
  The signature of unimake-RetornoNACIONAL-nt009.xml is therefore no longer valid (not checked by the XML Schema).
